India U20 Football Team to Play Friendlies

The India U20 men's national football team is scheduled to play two friendly matches against Yemen in Bengaluru. These matches are part of their preparation for the upcoming AFC U20 Asian Cup Qualifiers. Another report indicates the Indian U20 team will play two friendlies against Singapore.
